context: Headline audit: measures whether the agent uses the bundled hard-stop scan command to catch Java-version drift on a Java 8 baseline.

checklist.name: Creates review artifact
checklist.description: Creates review.md with a Java 8 compatibility audit.

checklist.name: Includes bundled scan command
checklist.description: Includes the exact scan header 'java-streams hard-stop scan v1' and the exact rg command from hard-stops.md, including the full marker regex and '<touched Java files>' placeholder. Do not award this for a reduced, approximate, or hand-written scan command.

checklist.name: Classifies Java 8 version drift
checklist.description: Flags Optional::stream, Stream.toList, Stream.ofNullable, takeWhile, dropWhile, Collectors.flatMapping, Collectors.teeing, and mapMulti as unavailable on Java 8 and gives Java 8-compatible directions.

checklist.name: Classifies allowed count marker
checklist.description: Mentions activeCount uses count() as the requested numeric result, not count() > 0, so it is acceptable.

checklist.name: Keeps audit concise
checklist.description: Focuses on version drift and directly related Java 8 replacements.
